summary: Alps Group Inc, a Malaysia-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a November 12, 2026 press release announcing the launch of a Pharmaco-Interaction laboratory unit within its MyGenome subsidiary, debuting with CYP450 inhibitory IC50 testing across seven major enzyme isoforms. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed; the item is an ordinary product-launch disclosure rather than a special situation. Operationally, the unit targets herbal, supplement and pharmaceutical manufacturers and research institutions in Southeast Asia; no risk-arb angle applies.
